title: Optional short process-summary content
description: Plain-text content for an A4 short summary. Stages form only a simple consecutive process. This recipe does not guarantee one page; render and review. Use full v2 for other layouts, complex relationships or unresolved required facts.

stages.description: Short stage titles in process order, at most 12 characters each. Descriptions belong in sections; no hidden merging or truncation.

text.description: One line of plain text, preserved without summarization. For formatting markup or multiline content use full v2.
